settlementFee.note: CENTRAL STRUCTURAL FINDING: Ohio's rating-bureau-uniform premium is set by OTIRB, whose 26 current members (per the Manual's own roster) include ALL FIVE national underwriters named in the task brief -- Chicago Title, Fidelity National Title, First American Title, Old Republic National Title, Stewart Title Guaranty -- plus WFG National Title. Unlike NJ's NJLTIRB, OTIRB does NOT regulate the settlement/closing fee itself: General Provision GP-4 states in so many words, 'The rates set forth herein do not include any charge made for title search, title examination, closing, or escrow services performed by the Insurer, or any of its approved attorneys or agents. Charges made for such services are in addition to the rates and charges set forth herein.' This is the exact unregulated territory the task brief targeted -- settlement/closing/escrow/search/exam fees are left entirely to the market in Ohio, for every provider type, with no carve-out procedure comparable to PA's Approved Attorney track or NJ's Article 6.
settlementFee.ownerPolicyOriginalRate_PR1: $5.80/thousand up to $250,000 of liability; +$4.10/thousand $250,001-$500,000; +$3.20/thousand $500,001-$1,000,000; +$3.10/thousand $1,000,001-$5,000,000; +$2.90/thousand $5,000,001-$10,000,000; +$2.60/thousand above that. Minimum Premium $225.00 (Homeowner's Policy variant: PR-1 rate +15%, minimum $250)
settlementFee.simultaneousIssueOwnerAndLoan_PR6: Combined rate = applicable Owner's Rate + $150 per Standard Loan Policy ($175 for Expanded Coverage Residential Loan Policy)
settlementFee.commitmentRate_PR11: $50-$100 per transaction, in addition to the policy rate; 20% cancellation charge (max $250) if no policy issues
settlementFee.closingProtectionCoverage_CP1: Rating-bureau-set (Section 6, Form CP-24): $40 lender, $55 seller(s), $20 buyer(s)/borrower(s), $20 each additional applicant; $40 minimum; remitted entirely to the Insurer (not the Agent)

itemizedFees.docPrep: NOT regulated by the Manual (GP-4 excludes 'closing' services generally, which providers interpret to include doc prep); no OTIRB-set figure
itemizedFees.courier: NOT regulated by the Manual (GP-4 excludes escrow/closing services from the rate); no OTIRB-set figure
itemizedFees.wire: NOT regulated by the Manual; no OTIRB-set figure
itemizedFees.searchExam: Examination charge is explicitly excluded from the rate by GP-4 ('title search, title examination... performed by the Insurer, or any of its approved attorneys or agents. Charges made for such services are in addition to the rates')
itemizedFees.cpl: $40 (lender) / $55 (seller) / $20 (buyer-borrower) / $20 (each additional applicant); $40 minimum -- see settlementFee.closingProtectionCoverage_CP1 above (Section 6, CP-1)
itemizedFees.binder: Title Guaranty (Record Products) rate: $3.50/thousand up to $100,000, +$3.00/thousand $100,001-$250,000, +$2.50/thousand above; $105 minimum (Section 4, RP-1) -- this is OTIRB's own 'Title Guaranty' record-product line, a substitute-for-insurance product used in the state's Torrens-adjacent judicial-report system, not identical to a 'binder' in the conventional sense but the closest Manual-rated analog

other.name: Preliminary Judicial Report (non-foreclosure)
other.amount: $3.00/thousand of fair market value, $75 minimum (Section 4, RP-2)

bundlingNotes: OTIRB's GP-4 is the most direct 'no carve-out needed' unregulated-settlement-fee statement found in this survey: rather than creating a special attorney-only track (PA) or promulgating the settlement fee itself (NJ), Ohio's rating bureau simply states up front that search/examination/closing/escrow are never part of the regulated rate for ANY provider type -- Company, Agent, or approved attorney alike. This means the entire settlement/service-fee stack the task brief asked about is, structurally, 100% unregulated in Ohio; the OTIRB Manual is cited here purely for the premium reference and the one closing-adjacent item it does price (the CPL, Section 6).
transactionContext: Applies uniformly statewide, all 88 counties, to all 26 OTIRB member insurers/agents' Owner's and Loan policy premiums alike; no purchase-vs-refinance distinction in the base rate (separate Refinance/Reissue rate rules apply based on prior-policy timing, not transaction type per se).
